questions.stem: Which of the following monoclonal antibodies is a HER - 2 inhibitor?
questions.solutionHtml:
Pertuzumab
  • Pertuzumab is a HER2 inhibitor used for breast cancer.
  • Hence option A is correct.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 661-662, 1209

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs acts as an inhibitor of PCSK9?
questions.solutionHtml:
Evolocumab
  • In 2015, two antibodies that target PCSK9, alirocumab and evolocumab, were approved by the FDA for clinical use in FH and other lipid disorders.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 615

questions.stem: A G2P1 delivered a preterm baby at 36 weeks. The baby was admitted in the NICU for a week and was given expressed breast milk. Unfortunately, the baby did not survive. Which of the following drugs can be used to reduce the engorgement and pain of the lactating breasts?
questions.solutionHtml:
Cabergoline
  • Cabergoline is the preferred drug for the treatment of hyperprolactinemia,  reduces breast engorgement or breast pain because of greater efficacy and lower adverse effects.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 777

questions.stem: Which of the following drugs for diabetes is LEAST likely to cause weight gain?
questions.solutionHtml:
Liraglutide
  • GLP-1 receptor agonists are usually associated with weight loss due to their ability to enhance satiety. In clinical trials, liraglutide caused both improvement in glycemic control and weight loss.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 292-293

questions.stem: Which of the following anti leprosy medications causes skin pigmentation?
questions.solutionHtml:
Clofazimine
  • Clofazimine is an anti leprosy drug.
  • The major disadvantage is reddish-black discolouration of skin, especially on exposed parts.
  • Discoloration of hair and body secretions may also occur, but is harmless. Dryness of skin, itching and scaling is often troublesome.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 832- 833

questions.stem: Which of the following diuretics is matched correctly with its location of action.Osmotic diuretics - Distal convoluted tubule.Thiazide diuretics - proximal convoluted tubule.Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors - proximal convoluted tubule.Potassium sparing diuretics - collecting ductSelect the correct answer from the given below code:
questions.solutionHtml:
C,D

Site of action of Thiazides, CA inhibitors, and K sparing diuretics are correctly matched.

  • Thiazide diuretics - proximal convoluted tubule.
  • Carbonic anhydrase inhibitors - proximal convoluted tubule.
  • Potassium sparing diuretics - collecting duct


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 626- 632

questions.stem: A patient with a known case of diabetes, shows microalbuminuria on urine analysis, done twice at an interval of 6 months. Renal function tests are normal. Which of the following drugs is not useful in preventing the progression of renal damage?
questions.solutionHtml:
Hydrochlorothiazide
  • Hydrochlorothiazide is not useful in preventing the progression of renal damage.
  • It is a thiazide diuretic, it causes hyperglycemia (increases blood sugar) and can worsen this patient condition.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 631- 633

questions.stem: Coagulation profile monitoring is required for which of the following drugs?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lepirudin
  • Lepirudin is a recombinant form of hirudin, should be used cautiously in patients with decreased renal function, and serum creatinine and aPTT should be monitored daily.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 591- 592

questions.stem: Which hypoglycemic drug increases the risk of urinary tract infections (UTI)?
questions.solutionHtml:
Dapagliflozin
  • Dapagliflozin is an SGLT2 inhibitor and causes glycosuria which can predispose to urinary and genital infections, electrolyte imbalance, ketoacidosis and increased urinary frequency.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 301

questions.stem: Patient with pulmonary aspergillosis was treated with Voriconazole. Which of the following is false about Voriconazole?

options.label: A
options.text: Should be taken on empty stomach

questions.solutionHtml:
Should be co-administered with pyrazinamide
  • Voriconazole is hepatotoxic and pyrazinamide is also highly hepatotoxic Anti TB drug, when co administered together can precipitate hepatic damage.
  • Hence these should not be co-administered.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 846- 847

questions.stem: A patient presents with complaints of a cough producing tenacious white sputum. Which of the following statements is true about the drug that could be prescribed for this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Codeine as it is a potent drug and quickly relieves symptoms.

options.label: B
options.text: Bromhexine and Dextromethorphan syrup as they liquefy sputum as reduce cough due to antitussive effect

options.label: C
options.text: Dextromethorphan alone as it does not have addictive potential like codeine

questions.solutionHtml:
Bromhexine as it liquefies sputum
  • Here patient is having sputum which means it is a productive cough, and we need to remove sputum to avoid further infection.
  • So DOC will be expectorant.

Drugs for Productive cough-

  • B-Bromhexine
  • A-Ambroxol
  • N- N Acetylcysteine
  • So option D is correct.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 238 - 241

questions.stem: Inhaled Nitric oxide (iNO) is used for________:
questions.solutionHtml:
Persistent pulmonary hypertension of newborn
  • Inhaled NO is FDA-approved for only one indication, persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 401

questions.stem: A 45-year-old patient presented with enterococcal endocarditis, who is allergic to penicillin. Which of the following drugs should be preferred in this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Vancomycin
  • Vancomycin-  In combination with an aminoglycoside, it may be used for enterococcal endocarditis in patients with serious penicillin allergy or for penicillin-resistant isolates.


KD Tripathi Essential of Pharmacology, 8th Edition, Page No. 806- 807
